pay_detail: 2026 tuition was $8,000 (includes room and board for 5 weeks). Need-based financial aid is available. $60 application fee, which can be waived for families with financial need.
name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Film and Video Division
what_you_do: Spend 5 weeks on the Northwestern campus making films. Take courses such as acting for the screen, sound and on-set work, and finish with a festival of student films.
who_can_apply: Students in their sophomore or junior year who will be rising juniors or seniors. The page asks for a class rank in or near the top 30 percent. It also asks for proof of special skill or strong interest in media arts.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: early deadline January 9, 2026 and regular deadline March 13, 2026, with rolling late applications for some concentrations. 2027 dates are not posted yet. The home page says applications open in November.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application with the $60 fee. Then send extra materials. These may include two essays, a resume, a letter of recommendation, test scores and your transcript.
notes: Competitive and costly. Travel is not included. Aid is need-based only. Not a paid program.
